# flipper: source provenance

Authors: Mark Bell and contributors.

Source: https://github.com/MarkCBell/flipper/tree/318ae9133b91628fed6f6ebb674aa61e3ee6d7a7

License: MIT.

Original lamination and move implementations plus mapping-class examples from upstream tests. These require the pinned flipper package. The test that catches AssumptionError is not an independent oracle for all inputs.

Each copied upstream file is preserved without editing. See ../sources.tsv for original paths, Git blob identities and sizes. Only selected files are present; dependency closure is not claimed. Execution and numerical acceptance: NOT_RUN.
